title: Dental PPO Plans Frequency, Interval and Age Limit Schedule
content:
Frequency, interval and age limits under the Dental PPO Plans, per plan. Counts are per person per benefit period; intervals are in months; ages are in years.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oral evaluations per benefit period | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Prophylaxis cleanings per benefit period | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Prophylaxis plus periodontal maintenance, combined per benefit period | 0 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Bitewing x-ray interval (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 6 |
| Full-mouth series or panoramic film interval (months) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 36 | 36 |
| Topical fluoride age limit (years) | 14 | 14 | 16 | 19 | 19 | 19 |
| Topical fluoride applications per benefit period | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Sealant age limit (years) | 14 | 14 | 16 | 16 | 19 | 19 |
| Sealant interval per tooth (months) | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 24 |
| Scaling and root planing interval per quadrant (months) | 0 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Crown replacement interval per tooth (months) | 0 | 0 | 84 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Bridge or denture replacement interval (months) | 0 | 0 | 84 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Implant interval per tooth position (months) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

### Meaning of each line
- **Oral evaluations:** periodic, comprehensive or limited oral evaluations payable per person per benefit period.
- **Prophylaxis cleanings:** prophylaxis cleanings payable per person per benefit period.
- **Combined cleanings:** prophylaxis plus periodontal maintenance visits combined, payable per person per benefit period; 0 means periodontal maintenance is not covered.
- **Bitewing interval:** one set of bitewing x-rays per this many months, counted from the last paid bitewing date of service.
- **Full-mouth or panoramic interval:** one full-mouth series or panoramic film per this many months, counted from the last paid one.
- **Fluoride age limit:** topical fluoride is payable only for patients who have not reached this birthday on the date of service.
- **Fluoride count:** topical fluoride applications payable per person per benefit period.
- **Sealant age limit:** sealants on permanent molars are payable only for patients who have not reached this birthday on the date of service.
- **Sealant interval:** one sealant per tooth per this many months.
- **Scaling and root planing:** payable once per quadrant per this many months; 0 means not covered.
- **Crown replacement:** a crown on the same tooth is payable once per this many months counted from the prior crown's date of service; 0 means crowns are not covered.
- **Bridge or denture replacement:** a bridge or denture replacing the same teeth is payable once per this many months; 0 means not covered.
- **Implant interval:** one implant per tooth position per this many months; 0 means implants are not covered.
